book.title: The Master and Margarita
book.author: Mikhail Bulgakov
book.firstPublished: 1966–67 (censored, in the magazine Moskva); first full Soviet edition 1973
book.textFollowed: L. M. Yanovskaya's text, Sobranie sochinenii v 5 tomakh, vol. 5, Moscow: Khudozhestvennaya literatura, 1990
book.description: Bulgakov's great comic novel: the devil and his retinue spend a few spring days turning 1930s Moscow upside down, while a persecuted writer's novel tells how Pontius Pilate judged a wandering philosopher. A love story, a satire and a fable about cowardice and mercy.
book.cover: No cover art; the reader's paper cover fallback applies. No cover generation was done.
